builds.title: Wild Dwarf river guide, Barbarian 2
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (2 class HD, LA +0).
builds.speed: 30 ft. with fast movement, base 20 ft.
traits: Neutral good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +1, size +1. Touch 12, flat-footed 14 with uncanny dodge, armor check penalty 0. BAB +2, grapple +1. Fortitude +6, Reflex +1, Will +1.
Dwarf stability gives +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip when firmly grounded.
+3 racial on saves against poison, +4 racial against disease, and +2 racial against spells and spell-like abilities.
Fire resistance 5. Immune to Wild Dwarf knockout poison. Poison Use prevents accidental self-poisoning during application to a weapon.
AC 18 against giants while eligible for a Dexterity bonus to AC. Uncanny dodge retains Dexterity when flat-footed or against an invisible attacker. Weapon Focus adds +1 to handaxe attacks.
Fast Movement applies in light or medium armor and under a light or medium load. Nima is illiterate.
actions: Small handaxe +7 melee, 1d4+3 slashing, critical ×3. Add +1 to the attack against orcs and goblinoids.

Rage 1/day for up to 8 rounds. AC 12, HP 28 at full health, grapple +3, Fortitude +8, Reflex +1, Will +3. Handaxe +9 melee, 1d4+5. Lose the 4 bonus HP and become fatigued for the rest of the encounter when rage ends.
builds.tactics: Nima goes first along the bank and stops at the washed-out crossing. She holds the approach so the others can get to firm ground.

builds.title: Wild Dwarf trail scout, Rogue 2
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (2 class HD, LA +0).
traits: Neutral. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +3, size +1. Touch 14, flat-footed 13, armor check penalty 0. BAB +1, grapple −2. Fortitude +2, Reflex +6, Will +1.
Dwarf stability gives +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip when firmly grounded.
+3 racial on saves against poison, +4 racial against disease, and +2 racial against spells and spell-like abilities.
Fire resistance 5. Immune to Wild Dwarf knockout poison. Poison Use prevents accidental self-poisoning during application to a weapon.
AC 20 against giants while eligible for a Dexterity bonus to AC. Trapfinding. Evasion in light armor, except while helpless. Tumble synergy is included in Balance.
actions: Small handaxe +3 melee, 1d4+1 slashing, critical ×3. Small blowgun +5 ranged, 1 piercing, critical ×2, 10-ft. range increment. Point Blank Shot raises the blowgun to +6 and 2 piercing within 30 ft. before range penalties. Add +1 to either attack against orcs and goblinoids.
Sneak attack +1d6 when the target is denied Dexterity to AC or flanked. For ranged attacks, the target must be within 30 ft.
builds.tactics: Perrin checks the trail markers before the crew moves. If the crossing is contested, he uses cover to watch the far bank.

concepts.name: Nima Reedbend
concepts.motive: Get the survey party back across the river before it rises.
concepts.hook: Nima asks the party to wait on the bank while she finds a crossing.

concepts.name: Perrin Mossline
concepts.motive: Find which bridge supports failed before the next supply run.
concepts.hook: Perrin shows the party a washed-out trail marker and points to the old crossing.
